channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Inciter Art (Fractured Atlas): quarterly open call for essays, 'tending to the hearth' (USD 750 stipend)
item.description: Fractured Atlas (Inciter Art) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · USD 750 stipend per selected writer, paid by ACH deposit or check once the first draft is finished (a W-9 form is required). No submission fee.

item.title: VIA Art Fund: Artistic Production Grant (Spring 2027 cycle)
item.description: VIA Art Fund · deadline 05 Nov 2026 · $25,000 to $100,000 per project

item.title: Busan Metropolitan City: Open Call for Land / Ecological Art on Eulsukdo
item.description: Busan Metropolitan City, Urban Parks Division · deadline 22 Nov 2026 · One proposal selected. Artwork support KRW 380,000,000 (approx. EUR 235,000) plus artist fee KRW 20,000,000 (approx. EUR 12,500). No entry fee indicated.

item.title: Kulturstiftung des Bundes: General Project Funding, January 2027 round (Allgemeine Projektfoerderung)
item.description: Kulturstiftung des Bundes (German Federal Cultural Foundation) · deadline 31 Jan 2027 · No fixed ceiling, but total project costs must exceed EUR 50,000 to be eligible. The Foundation allocates up to EUR 10 million per year across this line. At least 20 percent of total project costs must be secured from own capital and/or third-party funding. No application fee.

item.title: Bertha Artivism Awards 2027
item.description: Bertha Foundation · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to USD 20,000 per one-year activist-art project. Free to apply.

item.description: Swarovski Foundation · deadline 09 Nov 2026 · EUR 20,000 grant per selected participant, plus a mentorship and education programme. No application fee.

item.description: First Flights Media Limited, with Kodak and Periscope · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Up to GBP 7,000 / USD 10,000 cash toward production; plus two Kodak awards of 5 x 400ft rolls of 16mm stock with full processing, and one USD 10,000 Periscope post-production package

item.description: White Rabbit Gallery · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · AUD 2,000 artist fee (split equally if a collaborative group); free to enter

item.description: Voices With Impact / Art Opening Minds · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · USD 7,500 production grant per filmmaking team

item.title: Frameline Completion Fund 2027
item.description: Frameline · deadline 09 Oct 2026 · Grants of up to USD 5,000, with a standard range of USD 1,000 to 5,000; the jury can recommend amounts above or below that range. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Epic MegaGrants 2026 (Cycle 2)
    https://www.unrealengine.com/megagrants
    Epic Games · deadline 04 Sep 2026 · Typical grants range from USD 5,000 to USD 75,000, with some exceptional projects receiving up to USD 150,000. Epic states that recipients continue to own their IP and may publish it however they wish, so this is a grant rather than an investment or equity deal. Grants up to and including USD 25,000 may be paid in a single instalment; larger grants are paid across several instalments tied to continued progress. Funds are for project and team expenses such as development and hiring; hardware purchases or rentals are approved only occasionally, case by case. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Sundance Collab x Merrell: Brand-Supported Storytelling Program 2026
    https://collab.sundance.org/catalog/Merrell-Brand-Supported-Storytelling-Program
    Sundance Collab (Sundance Institute) in collaboration with Merrell · deadline 18 Aug 2026 · USD 20,000 production budget per selected filmmaker to make and deliver the greenlit concept, cutdowns (:06, :15, :30) and stills. Includes an online brand-supported storytelling program, and a covered hotel stay for one participant to attend the Sundance Film Festival in January 2027. No application fee.
  • KNOWCASE Open Call 2027: permanent digital-culture installation in Madrid (Sonar+D x Fundacion Cotec)
    https://sonar.es/en/news/knowcase-open-call-2027
    Fundacion Cotec and Sonar+D · deadline 07 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 100,000 (plus VAT), all-inclusive: conceptualisation, design, technical development, production, installation, maintenance, documentation, artist fees, travel, accommodation and insurance.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
• FUJIFILM GFX Challenge Grant Program 2026
    https://www.fujifilm-x.com/global/gfx-challenge-grant-program/year-2026/
    FUJIFILM · deadline 17 Aug 2026 · 5 Global Grant Awards of USD 10,000 and 10 Regional Grant Awards of USD 5,000. All recipients also get complimentary use of a GFX System camera body (including the FUJIFILM GFX ETERNA 55 filmmaking camera) and two GF lenses for the duration of the project, plus mentoring and technical assistance from Fujifilm technicians and product experts. Total approximate retail value of all awards: USD 229,500. No purchase necessary; no entry fee.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 13 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Flickr x Black Women Photographers Grant 2026 (Traces of Connection)
    https://blackwomenphotographers.com/smugmug-flickr
    Flickr and Black Women Photographers (BWP) · deadline 06 Aug 2026 · USD 10,000 grant to invest in the recipient's practice, plus a two-year Flickr Pro and one-year SmugMug Pro membership; ten additional recipients each receive one-year Flickr Pro and SmugMug Pro memberships. No entry fee (BWP membership is free).

item.title: 5 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Mountainfilm: Commitment Grants & Emerging Filmmaker Fellowship
    https://www.mountainfilm.org/mountainfilm-initiatives/commitment-grants/
    Mountainfilm · deadline 16 Jul 2026 · Over USD 90,000 in total funding. Individual Commitment Grants range from USD 3,000 to 6,000. The Emerging Filmmaker Fellowship adds a yearlong mentorship, a cash award, and a funded trip to Telluride over Memorial Day weekend (travel, lodging, and a festival pass).
  • Prospect Art: NEW WORK Commission 2027 - "We Come in Pieces"
    https://www.prospectart.org/new-work-grant
    Prospect Art · deadline 16 Aug 2026 · NEW WORK: USD 1,500 commission for one artist, plus a featured website section and social promotion. BROADCAST: USD 125 screening or speaking fee if selected. ONE WORK: a published article (exposure). NOTE: a USD 10 administrative fee applies to apply, with a no-questions-asked waiver available on request before the deadline. PayPal account required to receive funds.
  • Doc Society: Climate Story Fund
    https://climatestoryunit.org/fund/
    Doc Society (Climate Story Unit) · deadline 24 Aug 2026 · Grants of up to USD 125,000. No application fee.
  • Liu Shiming Art Foundation: Artist Grants 2026
    https://www.lsmartfund.org/grants
    Liu Shiming Art Foundation · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Up to five grants of USD 5,000 each. Disbursed in two payments (USD 3,000 by 15 January 2027 and USD 2,000 on project completion). No application fee.
  • Fondazione Prada Film Fund 2026
    https://www.fondazioneprada.org/film-fund/?lang=en
    Fondazione Prada · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · EUR 1.5 million annual endowment supporting up to 14 projects. Individual grant amounts are set by the Fondazione Prada selection committee (no fixed per-stage bands published). No application fee.

item.title: 3 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 29 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Textile Exchange x Atmos: Fashion Regenerated 2026
    https://site.picter.com/fashion-regenerated-2026
    Textile Exchange (with Atmos) · deadline 20 Jul 2026 · Overall winner: a paid collaborative commission worth USD 10,000 with Textile Exchange to develop a new body of work documenting the evidence of regeneration, published through Atmos and Textile Exchange and shown at the 2026 conference. Two runners-up: work promoted by Textile Exchange and displayed at the conference exhibition, plus a USD 2,000 cash prize.
  • Eamonn McCabe Bursary 2026 (Royal Photographic Society)
    https://rps.org/opportunities/bursaries/eamonn-mccabe-bursary/
    The Royal Photographic Society (RPS), in partnership with Eamonn McCabe's family and The Guardian · deadline 03 Aug 2026 · GBP 3,000 to deliver a photography project on the theme of 'sporting endeavour'. The completed project will be published by The Guardian and the RPS, who will work with the recipient to bring the project to a wider audience.
  • Club Nothing: Community Music Fund
    https://nothing.tech/club-nothing
    Nothing · deadline 09 Aug 2026 · USD 40,000 fund total; four individuals or collectives each receive USD 10,000 to produce a club event, series, or festival. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 22 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Genera Short Film Fund 2026 (current round)
    https://generafilms.com/powered-by/genera
    Genera Films · deadline 30 Jun 2026 · Up to GBP 5,000 in funding for a short film project, any genre. Application requires either Pro Membership or a one-off funding fee (GBP 40 to GBP 50 depending on deadline tier).
